definitions.explanation: A tool used to remove pencil marks from paper. Made of rubber or similar material.

examples.japanese: {消|け}しゴム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{消|け}しゴム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{消|け}しゴム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消|け}します→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: I'll erase it with an eraser.

notes:
{消|け}しゴム is a tool for erasing pencil marks, part of basic stationery vocabulary.

ETYMOLOGY:
Combines ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to erase) + ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧ (rubber, from English 'gum').

COUNTER:
⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ is used: {一|いっ}{個|こ}, {二|に}{個|こ}, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {消|け}しゴムで⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to erase with an eraser
- {消|け}しゴムを⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use an eraser
- {消|け}しゴムを⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧: to lend an eraser

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧: pencil
- ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to erase
- ⟦{砂|すな}{消|け}し→砂消し：noentry⟧: ink eraser
